import Mathlib

structure TopoGraph where
  adj : Array (Array Nat)

def TopoGraph.well_formed (g : TopoGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.adj.size →
    ∀ v, v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → v < g.adj.size

def TopoGraph.size (g : TopoGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def TopoGraph.has_edge (g : TopoGraph) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  u < g.adj.size ∧
  v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[]

def TopoGraph.is_path (g : TopoGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
    g.has_edge (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0)

def TopoGraph.is_cycle (g : TopoGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  g.is_path p ∧ p.length > 1 ∧ p.head? = p.getLast?

def TopoGraph.graph_has_cycle (g : TopoGraph) : Prop :=
  ∃ p, g.is_cycle p

def TopoGraph.is_topological_ordering (g : TopoGraph) (order : Array Nat) : Prop :=
  -- Contains all nodes (size check + surjective)
  order.size = g.size ∧
  (∀ n, n < g.size → ∃ k, k < order.size ∧ order.getD k 0 = n) ∧
  -- No duplicates is implied by size check + surjective on finite set, but for completeness:
  (∀ i j, i < order.size → j < order.size → i ≠ j → order.getD i 0 ≠ order.getD j 0) ∧
  -- No back edges (if j < i, no edge order[i] -> order[j])
  (∀ i j, j < i → i < order.size →
     ¬ g.has_edge (order.getD i 0) (order.getD j 0))

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def topological_sort_precond (graph : TopoGraph) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  graph.well_formed
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
namespace TopoImpl

/-- Out-neighbours of `u` as a list. -/
def outs (g : TopoGraph) (u : Nat) : List Nat := (g.adj.getD u #[]).toList

/-- `u` is ready to be emitted: all of its out-neighbours have already left `rem`. -/
def okNode (g : TopoGraph) (rem : List Nat) (u : Nat) : Bool :=
  (outs g u).all (fun v => decide (v ∉ rem))

/-- Selection step of the peeling loop. -/
def pick (g : TopoGraph) (rem : List Nat) : Option Nat :=
  rem.find? (okNode g rem)

/-- Peeling loop: `rem` are the remaining nodes, `acc` the order built so far
    (nodes already emitted, in final order).  `fuel` bounds `rem.length`. -/
def loopF (g : TopoGraph) : Nat → List Nat → List Nat → Option (List Nat)
  | 0, _, acc => some acc
  | _ + 1, [], acc => some acc
  | fuel + 1, hd :: tl, acc =>
    match pick g (hd :: tl) with
    | none => none
    | some u => loopF g fuel ((hd :: tl).erase u) (u :: acc)

end TopoImpl
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def topological_sort (graph : TopoGraph)
    (h_precond : topological_sort_precond graph) : Option (Array Nat) :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  (TopoImpl.loopF graph graph.size (List.range graph.size) []).map List.toArray
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def topological_sort_postcond (graph : TopoGraph) (result : Option (Array Nat))
    (_ : topological_sort_precond graph) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  match result with
  | some order =>
      ¬ graph.graph_has_cycle ∧
      graph.is_topological_ordering order
  | none =>
      graph.graph_has_cycle
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
namespace TopoImpl

open List

/-! ### Small utility lemmas -/

lemma mem_outs_iff (g : TopoGraph) (u v : Nat) :
    v ∈ outs g u ↔ v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] := by
  simp [outs]

lemma okNode_true {g : TopoGraph} {rem : List Nat} {u : Nat}
    (h : okNode g rem u = true) : ∀ v ∈ outs g u, v ∉ rem := by
  intro v hv
  have := List.all_eq_true.mp h v hv
  simpa using this

lemma okNode_false {g : TopoGraph} {rem : List Nat} {u : Nat}
    (h : ¬ (okNode g rem u = true)) : ∃ v ∈ outs g u, v ∈ rem := by
  by_contra hc
  push_neg at hc
  exact h (List.all_eq_true.mpr (fun v hv => by simpa using hc v hv))

lemma pick_mem {g : TopoGraph} {rem : List Nat} {u : Nat}
    (h : pick g rem = some u) : u ∈ rem := by
  unfold pick at h
  exact List.mem_of_find?_eq_some h

lemma pick_ok {g : TopoGraph} {rem : List Nat} {u : Nat}
    (h : pick g rem = some u) : okNode g rem u = true := by
  unfold pick at h
  exact List.find?_some h

lemma pick_none {g : TopoGraph} {rem : List Nat}
    (h : pick g rem = none) : ∀ u ∈ rem, ¬ (okNode g rem u = true) := by
  unfold pick at h
  exact List.find?_eq_none.mp h

lemma head?_getD {p : List Nat} (h : 0 < p.length) : p.head? = some (p.getD 0 0) := by
  cases p with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons a t => simp

lemma getLast?_getD {p : List Nat} (h : 0 < p.length) :
    p.getLast? = some (p.getD (p.length - 1) 0) := by
  have h1 : p.length - 1 < p.length := by omega
  rw [List.getLast?_eq_getElem?, List.getElem?_eq_getElem h1]
  simp [List.getElem?_eq_getElem h1]

lemma toArray_getD (l : List Nat) (k : Nat) : l.toArray.getD k 0 = l.getD k 0 := by
  by_cases h : k < l.length
  · rw [Array.getD]
    simp [h]
  · rw [Array.getD]
    simp only [List.size_toArray]
    rw [dif_neg h]
    rw [List.getD_eq_default _ _ (by omega)]

lemma idxOf_cons_self (a : Nat) (l : List Nat) : (a :: l).idxOf a = 0 := by
  simp

lemma idxOf_cons_of_ne {a b : Nat} (l : List Nat) (h : a ≠ b) :
    (a :: l).idxOf b = l.idxOf b + 1 := by
  have hb : (a == b) = false := by simpa using h
  simp [List.idxOf, List.findIdx_cons, hb]

lemma idxOf_getElem_eq {l : List Nat} (hn : l.Nodup) {i : Nat} (hi : i < l.length) :
    l.idxOf l[i] = i := by
  have hmem : l[i] ∈ l := List.getElem_mem hi
  have h1 : l.idxOf l[i] < l.length := List.idxOf_lt_length_of_mem hmem
  have h2 : l[l.idxOf l[i]] = l[i] := List.getElem_idxOf h1
  exact (List.Nodup.getElem_inj_iff hn).mp h2

/-! ### The accumulator invariant -/

/-- `acc` is closed under successors, and every edge inside it points forward. -/
def Good (g : TopoGraph) (acc : List Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ u ∈ acc, ∀ v, g.has_edge u v → v ∈ acc ∧ acc.idxOf u < acc.idxOf v

/-! ### Cycle extraction when the loop gets stuck -/

/-- From a repetition `F i = F j` (`i < j`) along an edge-chain, build a cycle. -/
lemma cycle_from_repeat (g : TopoGraph) (F : Nat → Nat)
    (hFedge : ∀ k, g.has_edge (F k) (F (k + 1)))
    (i j : Nat) (hlt : i < j) (hFij : F i = F j) : g.graph_has_cycle := by
  set d := j - i with hd
  have hdpos : 0 < d := by omega
  set p : List Nat := (List.range (d + 1)).map (fun k => F (i + k)) with hp
  have hplen : p.length = d + 1 := by simp [hp]
  have hgetD : ∀ t, t < d + 1 → p.getD t 0 = F (i + t) := by
    intro t ht
    have ht' : t < p.length := by omega
    rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ ht']
    simp [hp]
  refine ⟨p, ⟨⟨by omega, ?_⟩, by omega, ?_⟩⟩
  · intro t ht
    rw [hplen] at ht
    rw [hgetD t (by omega), hgetD (t + 1) (by omega)]
    have : i + (t + 1) = (i + t) + 1 := by omega
    rw [this]
    exact hFedge (i + t)
  · rw [head?_getD (by omega), getLast?_getD (by omega), hplen]
    simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    rw [hgetD 0 (by omega), hgetD d (by omega), show i + d = j from by omega,
      Nat.add_zero]
    exact congrArg some hFij

lemma cycle_of_stuck (g : TopoGraph) (rem : List Nat) (x : Nat) (hx : x ∈ rem)
    (hstep : ∀ u ∈ rem, ∃ v ∈ rem, g.has_edge u v) : g.graph_has_cycle := by
  classical
  -- a computable successor choice inside `rem`
  set f : Nat → Nat :=
    fun u => ((outs g u).find? (fun v => decide (v ∈ rem))).getD u with hfdef
  have hf : ∀ u ∈ rem, f u ∈ rem ∧ g.has_edge u (f u) := by
    intro u hu
    obtain ⟨v, hv, he⟩ := hstep u hu
    have hvout : v ∈ outs g u := (mem_outs_iff g u v).mpr he.2
    rcases hfind : (outs g u).find? (fun v => decide (v ∈ rem)) with _ | w
    · exact absurd ((List.find?_eq_none.mp hfind) v hvout) (by simp [hv])
    · have hw1 : w ∈ outs g u := List.mem_of_find?_eq_some hfind
      have hw2 : w ∈ rem := by simpa using List.find?_some hfind
      have hfu : f u = w := by simp [hfdef, hfind]
      refine ⟨by rw [hfu]; exact hw2, ?_⟩
      rw [hfu]
      exact ⟨he.1, (mem_outs_iff g u w).mp hw1⟩
  -- the orbit of `x`
  set F : Nat → Nat := fun k => f^[k] x with hFdef
  have hFmem : ∀ k, F k ∈ rem := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => simpa [hFdef] using hx
    | succ k ih =>
      have : F (k + 1) = f (F k) := by simp [hFdef, Function.iterate_succ_apply']
      rw [this]
      exact (hf _ ih).1
  have hFedge : ∀ k, g.has_edge (F k) (F (k + 1)) := by
    intro k
    have : F (k + 1) = f (F k) := by simp [hFdef, Function.iterate_succ_apply']
    rw [this]
    exact (hf _ (hFmem k)).2
  -- pigeonhole
  set m := rem.toFinset.card with hm
  have hmaps : ∀ a ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), F a ∈ rem.toFinset := by
    intro a _
    simpa using hFmem a
  have hcard : rem.toFinset.card < (Finset.range (m + 1)).card := by
    simp [hm]
  obtain ⟨i, hi, j, hj, hij, hFij⟩ :=
    Finset.exists_ne_map_eq_of_card_lt_of_maps_to hcard hmaps
  -- wlog i < j
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hij with hlt | hlt
  · exact cycle_from_repeat g F hFedge i j hlt hFij
  · exact cycle_from_repeat g F hFedge j i hlt hFij.symm

/-! ### Loop specification -/

lemma loopF_none (g : TopoGraph) :
    ∀ fuel rem acc, rem.length ≤ fuel →
      (rem ++ acc).Perm (List.range g.adj.size) →
      loopF g fuel rem acc = none → g.graph_has_cycle := by
  intro fuel
  induction fuel with
  | zero =>
    intro rem acc hlen _ hres
    have : rem = [] := List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero (by omega)
    subst this
    simp [loopF] at hres
  | succ fuel ih =>
    intro rem acc hlen hperm hres
    cases rem with
    | nil => simp [loopF] at hres
    | cons hd tl =>
      have hmemlt : ∀ u ∈ hd :: tl, u < g.adj.size := by
        intro u hu
        have : u ∈ List.range g.adj.size :=
          hperm.mem_iff.mp (List.mem_append_left _ hu)
        simpa using this
      rcases hpick : pick g (hd :: tl) with _ | u
      · -- stuck: build a cycle
        refine cycle_of_stuck g (hd :: tl) hd (by simp) ?_
        intro w hw
        obtain ⟨v, hv1, hv2⟩ := okNode_false (pick_none hpick w hw)
        exact ⟨v, hv2, ⟨hmemlt w hw, (mem_outs_iff g w v).mp hv1⟩⟩
      · have hu : u ∈ hd :: tl := pick_mem hpick
        have hlen' : ((hd :: tl).erase u).length ≤ fuel := by
          rw [List.length_erase_of_mem hu]
          simp at hlen ⊢
          omega
        have hperm' : (((hd :: tl).erase u) ++ (u :: acc)).Perm (List.range g.adj.size) := by
          refine List.Perm.trans ?_ hperm
          calc ((hd :: tl).erase u) ++ (u :: acc)
              ~ u :: (((hd :: tl).erase u) ++ acc) := List.perm_middle
            _ = (u :: ((hd :: tl).erase u)) ++ acc := by simp
            _ ~ (hd :: tl) ++ acc :=
                List.Perm.append_right acc (List.perm_cons_erase hu).symm
        have hrec : loopF g fuel ((hd :: tl).erase u) (u :: acc) = none := by
          rw [loopF, hpick] at hres
          exact hres
        exact ih _ _ hlen' hperm' hrec

lemma loopF_some (g : TopoGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) :
    ∀ fuel rem acc out, rem.length ≤ fuel →
      (rem ++ acc).Perm (List.range g.adj.size) → Good g acc →
      loopF g fuel rem acc = some out →
      out.Perm (List.range g.adj.size) ∧ Good g out := by
  intro fuel
  induction fuel with
  | zero =>
    intro rem acc out hlen hperm hgood hres
    have hnil : rem = [] := List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero (by omega)
    subst hnil
    simp [loopF] at hres
    subst hres
    exact ⟨by simpa using hperm, hgood⟩
  | succ fuel ih =>
    intro rem acc out hlen hperm hgood hres
    cases rem with
    | nil =>
      simp [loopF] at hres
      subst hres
      exact ⟨by simpa using hperm, hgood⟩
    | cons hd tl =>
      have hnd : ((hd :: tl) ++ acc).Nodup :=
        hperm.nodup_iff.mpr (List.nodup_range)
      have hmemlt : ∀ u ∈ hd :: tl, u < g.adj.size := by
        intro u hu
        have : u ∈ List.range g.adj.size :=
          hperm.mem_iff.mp (List.mem_append_left _ hu)
        simpa using this
      rcases hpick : pick g (hd :: tl) with _ | u
      · rw [loopF, hpick] at hres; simp at hres
      · have hu : u ∈ hd :: tl := pick_mem hpick
        have hok : okNode g (hd :: tl) u = true := pick_ok hpick
        have hunotacc : u ∉ acc := by
          have := List.disjoint_of_nodup_append hnd
          exact this hu
        have hlen' : ((hd :: tl).erase u).length ≤ fuel := by
          rw [List.length_erase_of_mem hu]
          simp at hlen ⊢
          omega
        have hperm' : (((hd :: tl).erase u) ++ (u :: acc)).Perm (List.range g.adj.size) := by
          refine List.Perm.trans ?_ hperm
          calc ((hd :: tl).erase u) ++ (u :: acc)
              ~ u :: (((hd :: tl).erase u) ++ acc) := List.perm_middle
            _ = (u :: ((hd :: tl).erase u)) ++ acc := by simp
            _ ~ (hd :: tl) ++ acc :=
                List.Perm.append_right acc (List.perm_cons_erase hu).symm
        -- successors of `u` are already in `acc`
        have hsucc : ∀ v, g.has_edge u v → v ∈ acc := by
          intro v he
          have hvout : v ∈ outs g u := (mem_outs_iff g u v).mpr he.2
          have hvnotrem : v ∉ hd :: tl := okNode_true hok v hvout
          have hvlt : v < g.adj.size := hwf u he.1 v he.2
          have : v ∈ List.range g.adj.size := by simpa using hvlt
          have : v ∈ (hd :: tl) ++ acc := hperm.mem_iff.mpr this
          rcases List.mem_append.mp this with h | h
          · exact absurd h hvnotrem
          · exact h
        have hgood' : Good g (u :: acc) := by
          intro w hw v he
          rcases List.mem_cons.mp hw with rfl | hwacc
          · -- w = u
            have hvacc : v ∈ acc := hsucc v he
            have hvne : w ≠ v := by rintro rfl; exact hunotacc hvacc
            refine ⟨List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hvacc, ?_⟩
            rw [idxOf_cons_self, idxOf_cons_of_ne _ hvne]
            omega
          · obtain ⟨hvacc, hidx⟩ := hgood w hwacc v he
            have hwne : u ≠ w := by rintro rfl; exact hunotacc hwacc
            have hvne : u ≠ v := by rintro rfl; exact hunotacc hvacc
            refine ⟨List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hvacc, ?_⟩
            rw [idxOf_cons_of_ne _ hwne, idxOf_cons_of_ne _ hvne]
            omega
        have hrec : loopF g fuel ((hd :: tl).erase u) (u :: acc) = some out := by
          rw [loopF, hpick] at hres
          exact hres
        exact ih _ _ _ hlen' hperm' hgood' hrec

/-! ### From `Good` to the postcondition -/

lemma no_cycle_of_good {g : TopoGraph} {out : List Nat} (hg : Good g out)
    (hcov : ∀ u, u < g.adj.size → u ∈ out) : ¬ g.graph_has_cycle := by
  rintro ⟨p, ⟨hpos, hpath⟩, hp1, hhg⟩
  have h0mem : p.getD 0 0 ∈ out := hcov _ (hpath 0 (by omega)).1
  have key : ∀ t, t + 1 < p.length →
      (p.getD (t + 1) 0 ∈ out ∧ out.idxOf (p.getD 0 0) < out.idxOf (p.getD (t + 1) 0)) := by
    intro t
    induction t with
    | zero => intro h; exact hg _ h0mem _ (hpath 0 h)
    | succ t iht =>
      intro h
      have hprev := iht (by omega)
      have hnext := hg _ hprev.1 _ (hpath (t + 1) h)
      exact ⟨hnext.1, lt_trans hprev.2 hnext.2⟩
  have hlast := key (p.length - 2) (by omega)
  rw [show p.length - 2 + 1 = p.length - 1 from by omega] at hlast
  have heq : p.getD 0 0 = p.getD (p.length - 1) 0 := by
    rw [head?_getD (by omega), getLast?_getD (by omega)] at hhg
    exact Option.some.inj hhg
  rw [← heq] at hlast
  exact absurd hlast.2 (lt_irrefl _)

end TopoImpl
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem topological_sort_postcond_satisfied (graph : TopoGraph)
    (h_precond : topological_sort_precond graph) :
    topological_sort_postcond graph (topological_sort graph h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  classical
  have hwf : graph.well_formed := h_precond
  have hsz : graph.size = graph.adj.size := rfl
  have hlen0 : (List.range graph.size).length ≤ graph.size := by simp
  have hperm0 : ((List.range graph.size) ++ ([] : List Nat)).Perm
      (List.range graph.adj.size) := by simp [hsz]
  have hgood0 : TopoImpl.Good graph ([] : List Nat) := by
    intro u hu; simp at hu
  unfold topological_sort
  rcases hL : TopoImpl.loopF graph graph.size (List.range graph.size) [] with _ | out
  · simp only [hL, Option.map_none]
    exact TopoImpl.loopF_none graph _ _ _ hlen0 hperm0 hL
  · simp only [hL, Option.map_some]
    obtain ⟨hperm, hgood⟩ := TopoImpl.loopF_some graph hwf _ _ _ _ hlen0 hperm0 hgood0 hL
    have hnd : out.Nodup := hperm.nodup_iff.mpr List.nodup_range
    have hlen : out.length = graph.adj.size := by
      have := hperm.length_eq
      simpa using this
    have hcov : ∀ u, u < graph.adj.size → u ∈ out := by
      intro u hu
      exact hperm.mem_iff.mpr (by simpa using hu)
    refine ⟨TopoImpl.no_cycle_of_good hgood hcov, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [hlen, hsz]
    · intro n hn
      have hn' : n ∈ out := hcov n (by simpa [hsz] using hn)
      obtain ⟨k, hk, hkv⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.mp hn'
      refine ⟨k, by simpa using hk, ?_⟩
      rw [TopoImpl.toArray_getD, List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ hk]
      exact hkv
    · intro i j hi hj hne
      simp only [List.size_toArray] at hi hj
      rw [TopoImpl.toArray_getD, TopoImpl.toArray_getD,
        List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ hi, List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ hj]
      intro hcon
      exact hne ((List.Nodup.getElem_inj_iff hnd).mp hcon)
    · intro i j hji hi
      simp only [List.size_toArray] at hi
      have hj : j < out.length := by omega
      rw [TopoImpl.toArray_getD, TopoImpl.toArray_getD,
        List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ hi, List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ hj]
      intro he
      obtain ⟨_, hidx⟩ := hgood _ (List.getElem_mem hi) _ he
      rw [TopoImpl.idxOf_getElem_eq hnd hi, TopoImpl.idxOf_getElem_eq hnd hj] at hidx
      omega
  -- !benchmark @end proof

## What was implemented

A **Kahn-style peeling topological sort** (out-degree variant), entirely inside the four markers:

- `outs g u` — out-neighbour list; `okNode g rem u` — Boolean "all successors of `u` already left `rem`"; `pick g rem = rem.find? (okNode g rem)`.
- `loopF` — peels one ready node per round, prepending it to `acc`; returns `none` when `rem ≠ []` and nothing is ready. Fuel = `graph.size` (with the carried side condition `rem.length ≤ fuel`) instead of well-founded recursion.
- `topological_sort` = `loopF graph graph.size (List.range graph.size) [] |>.map List.toArray`.

## Proof structure

Two loop invariants, both carried through induction on the fuel:
1. `(rem ++ acc).Perm (List.range g.adj.size)` — gives the permutation clause, `Nodup`, and `rem`/`acc` disjointness.
2. `Good g acc` : `∀ u ∈ acc, ∀ v, has_edge u v → v ∈ acc ∧ acc.idxOf u < acc.idxOf v`.

- `some` branch: invariant 1 gives size/surjectivity/distinctness; invariant 2 plus `idxOf_getElem_eq` gives "no back edge", and `no_cycle_of_good` gives `¬ graph_has_cycle` (index strictly increases along any path, so head ≠ last).
- `none` branch: every remaining node has a successor in `rem`, so a computable successor function `f` is iterated from a remaining node; pigeonhole (`Finset.exists_ne_map_eq_of_card_lt_of_maps_to`) on `rem.toFinset` yields `f^[i] x = f^[j] x`, and `cycle_from_repeat` builds the explicit witness `(List.range (j-i+1)).map (fun k => f^[i+k] x)`.

## Semantic audit vs TASK.md

- Both postcondition branches proved for real; the `none` branch produces an explicit cycle list, not an assumption.
- Precondition `well_formed` is genuinely used (to place successors inside `List.range size`).
- Empty graph → `some #[]`, postcondition vacuous. Self-loops: `u ∈ rem` permanently blocks `okNode`, so the algorithm returns `none` — this matters, because the spec's back-edge clause (`j < i` only) does *not* itself forbid `u → u`, so `¬ graph_has_cycle` had to be proved from the stronger `Good` invariant rather than from `is_topological_ordering`. Isolated nodes, multiple components, and duplicate adjacency entries are handled.
- No `sorry`/`admit`/axioms/`partial`/`unsafe`, no `Nat.find`, no `Classical.choose`, no sorting, no brute-force enumeration, no specification oracle. The only `decide` is `decide (v ∉ rem)`, a list-membership test inside the algorithm — not a decision over the target property. `classical` appears only as a proof tactic.

`AlgorithmPlan.md` and `ProofState.md` are filled in; the delivered implementation matches the committed plan, including the stated `O(V·(V+E))` complexity (asymptotically weaker than the in-degree-counter form of the same algorithm — chosen deliberately for proof tractability, and noted in the plan).

analysis:
The student does implement a genuine topological-sorting-style algorithm from scratch rather than calling a library routine or leaving the body empty.

What the code does:
- It starts with all vertices `0 .. size-1` in `rem`.
- It repeatedly picks a vertex `u` in `rem` such that all of its outgoing neighbors are not in `rem` anymore (`okNode`).
- It removes `u` from `rem` and prepends it to `acc`.
- If no such vertex exists, it returns `none`.

This is essentially the standard sink-removal variant of topological sort. Because chosen nodes are prepended to `acc`, the final order is consistent with topological ordering.

On the verification side, within the student-owned regions, they also provide substantial proofs:
- `loopF_some` shows that if the loop returns `some out`, then `out` is a permutation of all nodes and satisfies a strong edge-order invariant (`Good`).
- `no_cycle_of_good` proves acyclicity from that invariant.
- `loopF_none` plus `cycle_of_stuck` prove that if the algorithm gets stuck and returns `none`, then the graph has a cycle.

This directly addresses the natural-language requirements:
1. If returning `Some(order)`, they prove it is a topological ordering over all nodes.
2. If returning `None`, they prove the graph contains a cycle.

There is no evidence of cheating in the student-owned regions:
- No `sorry`, `admit`, or trivial placeholder bodies there.
- No use of an existing topological sort implementation.
- The algorithm is explicitly implemented.

One subtle point: the algorithm removes sinks rather than sources, but that is still a valid topological sort algorithm when the output is accumulated appropriately, which it is (`u :: acc`). So this still satisfies the intended algorithmic requirement.

Overall, the student solution matches the required semantics and includes the required cycle-detection correctness argument.
